name: Dipula Properties Limited
source: Dipula Income Fund / Dipula Properties Limited consolidated financial statements for the year ended 31 August 2021, audited, statement of comprehensive income. Profit Before Tax 568,920,000 less Income Tax 85,720,000 equals Net Profit 483,200,000 ZAR. Corroborated by the same file: the printed R1,314 million revenue equals the stored FY2021 Revenue of 1,314,000,000 and the printed basic earnings of 81.14 cents per share equals the stored FY2021 EPS of 0.811388, which divides into 483,200,000 at Dipula's 595.5 million shares in issue. This mirrors the value already carried in the DIB.JO statement so the two keys for the same security agree.

rows.label: Gross Profit
rows.derivedFormula: Gross Profit = Revenue - Cost of Sales

rows.label: Operating Expenses
rows.withhold_reason: withheld: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses does not equal the filed Operating Profit and the file carries no extra line that explains the gap, so the operating expenses (or operating profit) cannot be established from the statement; an honest blank beats a figure that fails its own arithmetic
rows.derivedFrom: Operating Expenses = Gross Profit - Operating Profit (EBIT)
rows.derivedBasis: identity holds in every other period of this same file

rows.label: Net Profit
rows.derivedFrom: Profit Before Tax less Income Tax

derivedCellsNote: Individual blank cells derived from the same file own printed inputs, each tagged derived true with its formula and identity agreement rate.
reconciliation_note: Gross Profit - Operating Expenses = Operating Profit (EBIT) does not hold in FY2021; the operating expenses for those periods are withheld (see the row note).
